decision: D-073 (3) (the user: "Approve both (Recommended)", 2026-11-07T08:33Z), on T-071's design 5.2 and R-021
status: before any P4 data and before the code it judges; docs/P4_SLOW_DESIGN.md's dated row D-073 (3)

halving.modelled_on: ml/p1_prereg.json halving (D-049) and ml/p1_prereg_4.json halving (D-058's guard)
halving.when: before the ladder, on a pilot seed only, never on a validation or an evaluation seed

health.judge: eval/p4_outcome.control_health on each of the two controls (D-046, D-050)

halving.step: halvings + 1, both controls again on the same seed, so that only the mix moves
halving.stop: the first step counting up from 0 whose two controls are sound and healthy: its halvings is the factor. No step runs after it
halving.unsound: a control whose run checks fail, or that never ran, gives no reading and fires nothing: the step is repeated at the same halvings, at most max_reruns times; past that the rule gives no factor
halving.halved: the browser devices: 40, 20, 10 (ml/p4_traffic.browser_devices); the last ones of the list are dropped
halving.never_removed: CGNAT-12, CGNAT-24 and every other benign entity
halving.at_the_floor: still unhealthy at max_halvings: there is no factor. The ladder, the validation and the campaign refuse and say so; going on is a new decision, not a further step of this rule
halving.stop_for_decision: D-058's guard: a control unhealthy with a server-side Q of at least server_q_min stops the rule for a dated decision (fire, or repeat as no reading) instead of firing it: the limit is the client's or a timer's, and a halving would shrink the benign mix for nothing
halving.factor_file: eval/p4_health.py --out writes p4-health/1, bound to the calibration record's sha256; the ladder, the validation and the campaign run at its factor (eval/p4_runner.py --health)
halving.in_the_ladder: an unhealthy C of a ladder block makes that attempt unsound, to be re-run with that reason; it never fires the rule
